roadmaps.title: Flutter Developer
roadmaps.description: Build apps for Android and iOS from one Dart codebase, from the language to architecture and testing.

topics.title: Dart fundamentals
topics.description: Variables, functions, classes and collections: the language every Flutter app is written in.
objectives: Declare variables with var, final and const
Write functions with named and optional parameters
Model data with classes and records

topics.title: Null safety
topics.description: Dart's type system separates values that can be null from values that can't, and checks it at compile time.
objectives: Promote a nullable value with a check

topics.title: Futures and async/await
topics.description: Work that finishes later: network calls, files, timers. Futures represent it; async and await keep it readable.
objectives: Await a Future and handle its errors
Know when code runs on the event loop

topics.title: Streams
topics.description: A sequence of values over time: user input, database changes, sockets. The backbone of reactive Flutter apps.
objectives: Listen to a stream and cancel the subscription
Transform streams with map, where and asyncMap

topics.title: Widgets and the widget tree
topics.description: Everything on screen is a widget. Learn how widgets compose, rebuild and keep state.
objectives: Choose between stateless and stateful widgets

topics.title: Layout
topics.description: Rows, columns, stacks and constraints: how Flutter decides the size and position of every widget.
objectives: Explain 'constraints go down, sizes go up'
Build responsive layouts with Flex and LayoutBuilder

topics.title: Navigation and routing
topics.description: Move between screens, pass data, handle deep links and keep tab state with a router.

topics.title: State management
topics.description: Where state lives and how the UI follows it: from setState to Cubits, Blocs and streams.
objectives: Model screen states as immutable classes
Choose a Cubit or a Bloc

topics.title: Dependency injection
topics.description: Hand classes what they need instead of letting them create it, so they can be tested and replaced.

topics.title: Local persistence
topics.description: Keep data on the device: preferences for small values, SQLite with drift for everything else.
objectives: Define tables and queries with drift
Watch a query as a stream

topics.title: Testing
topics.description: Unit, widget and integration tests: proving the app works, and keeping it working.
objectives: Pump a widget and interact with it
Use fakes instead of real services

topics.title: Performance
topics.description: Smooth frames and fast starts: measure first, then fix rebuilds, layouts and jank.

roadmaps.title: Backend Developer
roadmaps.description: Design and ship APIs with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, packaged with Docker.

topics.title: Python essentials
topics.description: The syntax, data structures and tooling of the language most backends here are written in.
objectives: Manage packages in a virtual environment

topics.title: HTTP and REST
topics.description: Requests, responses, methods and status codes: the protocol every API speaks.
objectives: Pick the right method and status code

topics.title: FastAPI
topics.description: Build typed, documented APIs quickly, with validation from Python type hints.

topics.title: Authentication
topics.description: Who is calling: passwords, tokens and sessions, and keeping them safe.

topics.title: PostgreSQL
topics.description: A relational database: tables, constraints, transactions and the guarantees they give.
objectives: Model tables with keys and constraints

topics.title: SQL queries and indexes
topics.description: Joins, aggregates and the indexes that make them fast.
objectives: Write joins and GROUP BY queries
Choose an index for a query

topics.title: Docker
topics.description: Package an app and its dependencies into an image that runs the same everywhere.

roadmaps.title: AI Engineer
roadmaps.description: Build with large language models: prompting, retrieval, tools and agents.

topics.title: Prompt engineering
topics.description: Clear instructions, examples and structure: getting reliable answers from a model.
objectives: Iterate on a prompt with test cases

topics.title: Embeddings and vector databases
topics.description: Turn text into vectors and find similar meaning with a nearest-neighbour search.

topics.title: Retrieval-augmented generation
topics.description: Give a model the right documents at question time, so it answers from your data.

topics.title: Orchestration with LangChain
topics.description: Chain model calls, retrievers and tools with a framework.

topics.title: Model Context Protocol
topics.description: An open protocol for connecting models to tools and data sources.
objectives: Connect a server to a client

topics.title: AI agents
topics.description: Models that plan, call tools and act over several steps, and how to keep them reliable.

topics.title: Evaluating LLM apps
topics.description: Measure quality with test sets, graders and regressions, not impressions.

roadmaps.title: System Design
roadmaps.description: Design systems that scale: the building blocks and the trade-offs between them.

topics.title: Scalability
topics.description: Handling more users and data: vertical and horizontal scaling, and stateless services.

topics.title: Consistency and CAP
topics.description: What a distributed system can promise when the network fails.

topics.title: Load balancers
topics.description: Spread traffic across servers and route around failures.

topics.title: Caching
topics.description: Serve repeated reads from memory: where to cache, and how to keep it fresh.

topics.title: Message queues
topics.description: Decouple producers from consumers and absorb bursts of work.

topics.title: Rate limiting
topics.description: Protect a service from overload and abuse with token buckets and sliding windows.

resources.title: A tour of the Dart language
Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
Please stop calling databases CP or AP

challenges.title: FizzBuzz as a stream
challenges.prompt: Write a function that returns a Stream<String> of FizzBuzz from 1 to n: "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for 5, "FizzBuzz" for both, the number otherwise.
hints: Start from Stream.fromIterable over 1..n.
map each number to its word.
Test it with expectLater and emitsInOrder.

challenges.title: Debounce a stream
challenges.prompt: Write a stream transformer that only emits a value after the source has been quiet for a given duration, as a search field needs.
hints: A Timer per value: cancel the previous one.
Emit the latest value when the timer fires.
Don't forget to close when the source is done.

challenges.title: An LRU cache
challenges.prompt: Implement a cache with a fixed capacity that evicts the least recently used entry when full. get and put should run in constant time.
hints: A LinkedHashMap keeps insertion order.
Re-insert a key on every read to mark it recent.
Evict the first key when over capacity.

challenges.title: A responsive card grid
challenges.prompt: Build a grid of cards that shows one column on a phone, two on a small tablet and four on a wide screen.
hints: LayoutBuilder gives you the available width.
Pick a column count from breakpoints.
GridView.builder with SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount.

challenges.title: An animated FAQ
challenges.prompt: Build a list of questions where tapping one expands its answer with an animation, and only one stays open at a time.
hints: Keep the open index in the parent's state.
AnimatedSize or AnimatedCrossFade animate the height.
Announce the expanded state to screen readers.

challenges.title: An infinite list with paging
challenges.prompt: Show a list that loads the next page when the user nears the end, with a loading row, an error row with retry, and no duplicate requests.
hints: Listen to the scroll position, or build a sentinel item.
Ignore load requests while one is in flight.
Model the list state as a sealed class.

challenges.title: Top three per group
challenges.prompt: Given orders(customer_id, amount, created_at), return each customer's three largest orders.
hints: A window function can number rows per customer.
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY … ORDER BY …).
Filter on the row number in an outer query.

challenges.title: Running totals
challenges.prompt: Given payments(day, amount), return every day with its running total since the first day.
hints: SUM can be a window function.
Order the window by day.
Think about days with no payments.

challenges.title: Find the gaps
challenges.prompt: Given a table of activity days, find every gap: the first and last missing day of each run of days without activity.
hints: Compare each day with the next one (LEAD).
A gap exists where the difference is more than one day.
This is how a streak can be computed in SQL.

challenges.title: Design a URL shortener
challenges.prompt: Design a service that turns long URLs into short ones and redirects. Expect 100 million new links a month and ten times as many reads.
hints: Estimate storage and read traffic first.
How will you generate short, unique keys?
Reads dominate: where does a cache go?

challenges.title: Design a rate limiter
challenges.prompt: Design a rate limiter for an API gateway that allows each client 100 requests a minute across many gateway servers.
hints: Compare token bucket and sliding window.
Where is the shared counter kept?
What happens when the counter store is down?

challenges.title: Design a news feed
challenges.prompt: Design the home feed of a social app: posts from the people you follow, newest first, for 50 million daily users.
hints: Fan-out on write or on read?
Celebrities break fan-out on write.
Cache the first page of each feed.
